description: This file contains SwiftUI views, actors, and helper structures/classes related to session preview feature in a macOS application. It manages fetching, caching, and displaying session message previews, along with concurrency control mechanisms.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: A singleton actor responsible for caching and retrieving session preview snapshots with timestamp-based expiration.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: A singleton actor managing limited concurrent access permits for preview fetch operations.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieve a cached snapshot for a session key if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Store a snapshot into cache for a specific session key.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieve the last snapshot stored for a session key.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Acquire a permit to perform an async operation with concurrency control.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preload session previews for a list of session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load a session preview snapshot, using cache if available and valid.
